## Activity

During January 2025, River Outreach recorded 62 captures. This activity provides the basis for the month’s operational review and supports consideration of both image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total is reported as supplied for the site and month.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 13 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 21.0 per cent. This result is noted for operational monitoring and should be considered alongside the site’s reported activity. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk, so that relevant problems can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 5 days. This measure records the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading for the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag provide a concise view of grading activity at River Outreach during January 2025. The figures should be retained for routine review of site operations, image quality, and grading performance.
